    <p><strong>Media and controls.</strong> Signed relative error on holdout totals: (truth − estimate) ÷ truth. We exclude near-zero true totals.</p>
    <p><strong>Sales forecast.</strong> Holdout mean absolute error (MAE) divided by mean context sales.</p>
    <p><strong>Results percentages.</strong> Graph-averaged River versus constant-intercept PyMC-Marketing on all paired fits across six tests. Mean forecast MAE: 7.63% versus 6.86%. Median absolute error on scored media and control totals: 16.63% versus 63.14%, not error by individual input.</p>
  </div>
  <div id="benchmark-fits-info" class="mfm-info-popover mfm-benchmark-popover" popover="auto">
    <p><strong>All paired fits.</strong> Every method uses the same cases, including MCMC fits that failed sampling checks.</p>
    <p><strong>Convergence only.</strong> A fit must have no divergences, maximum R-hat at most 1.2, and minimum bulk and tail effective sample sizes of at least 100. The filter applies separately to each MCMC method, so the cases can differ. Both River modes keep all their cases.</p>
  </div>

<details class="mfm-test-panel" id="test-twelve-channels" name="mfm-attribution-cases">
  <summary><span class="mfm-test-number">2</span> Twelve media channels</summary>
  <div class="mfm-case-body">
  <p class="mfm-case-setup">All twelve channels and three controls are visible and active. Twelve channels goes beyond River’s training range of one to ten.</p>
    <div class="mfm-case-options">
      <fieldset class="mfm-metric-choice" aria-labelledby="error-label-twelve-channels">
        <legend><span id="error-label-twelve-channels">Error measure</span><button type="button" class="mfm-info" popovertarget="benchmark-error-info" aria-label="About error measures"></button></legend>
        <label><input type="radio" name="error-twelve-channels" value="media" checked> Media</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="error-twelve-channels" value="controls"> Controls</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="error-twelve-channels" value="sales"> Sales forecast</label>
      </fieldset>
      <fieldset class="mfm-metric-choice mfm-fit-choice" aria-labelledby="fits-label-twelve-channels">
        <legend><span id="fits-label-twelve-channels">Fits included</span><button type="button" class="mfm-info" popovertarget="benchmark-fits-info" aria-label="About fits and sampling checks"></button></legend>
        <label><input type="radio" name="fits-twelve-channels" value="all" checked> All paired fits</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="fits-twelve-channels" value="converged"> Convergence only</label>
      </fieldset>
    </div>
    <p class="mfm-fit-note" data-fit-scope="all">Every method uses the same cases, including MCMC fits that did not pass sampling checks.</p>
    <p class="mfm-fit-note" data-fit-scope="converged">Fits retained: River 75/75 per mode; constant intercept 18/75; time-varying intercept 0/75; reference 51/75. Case sets can differ by method. Counts are before any metric exclusions.</p>
    <section class="mfm-error-panel" data-metric="media">
      <h4>Total media error</h4>
      <p>Signed relative error (%) · negative means overestimation</p>
      <div data-fit-scope="all">
        <div class="mfm-error-row" data-series="river">

  <summary><span class="mfm-test-number">3</span> One channel hidden</summary>
  <div class="mfm-case-body">
  <p class="mfm-case-setup">Remove one active media channel from the inputs. Its effect remains in sales. Score only the visible contributions. The generator-informed reference knows the omitted channel.</p>

      <fieldset class="mfm-metric-choice" aria-labelledby="error-label-hidden-channel">

        <label><input type="radio" name="fits-hidden-channel" value="converged"> Convergence only</label>
      </fieldset>

    <p class="mfm-fit-note" data-fit-scope="all">Every method uses the same cases, including MCMC fits that did not pass sampling checks.</p>
    <p class="mfm-fit-note" data-fit-scope="converged">Fits retained: River 75/75 per mode; constant intercept 25/75; time-varying intercept 0/75; reference 48/75. Case sets can differ by method. Counts are before any metric exclusions.</p>

<details class="mfm-test-panel" id="test-market-inspired" name="mfm-attribution-cases">
  <summary><span class="mfm-test-number">5</span> Luxury Brand Based</summary>
  <div class="mfm-case-body">
  <p class="mfm-case-setup">We used real media spend data from a luxury brand with infrequent repeat purchases. The synthetic data follow similar spend patterns. The simulation has no confounding. The reference uses the simulator’s structure.</p>
    <div class="mfm-case-options">
      <fieldset class="mfm-metric-choice" aria-labelledby="error-label-market-inspired">
        <legend><span id="error-label-market-inspired">Error measure</span><button type="button" class="mfm-info" popovertarget="benchmark-error-info" aria-label="About error measures"></button></legend>
        <label><input type="radio" name="error-market-inspired" value="media" checked> Media</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="error-market-inspired" value="controls"> Controls</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="error-market-inspired" value="sales"> Sales forecast</label>
      </fieldset>
      <fieldset class="mfm-metric-choice mfm-fit-choice" aria-labelledby="fits-label-market-inspired">
        <legend><span id="fits-label-market-inspired">Fits included</span><button type="button" class="mfm-info" popovertarget="benchmark-fits-info" aria-label="About fits and sampling checks"></button></legend>
        <label><input type="radio" name="fits-market-inspired" value="all" checked> All paired fits</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="fits-market-inspired" value="converged"> Convergence only</label>
      </fieldset>
    </div>
    <p class="mfm-fit-note" data-fit-scope="all">Every method uses the same cases, including MCMC fits that did not pass sampling checks.</p>
    <p class="mfm-fit-note" data-fit-scope="converged">Fits retained: River 75/75 per mode; constant intercept 16/75; time-varying intercept 0/75; reference 0/75. Case sets can differ by method. Counts are before any metric exclusions.</p>
